GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 1kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Slow to begin. When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that the mare, which was first up today, raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages and did not settle as he had hoped. He could offer no other explanation for the performance but added that, in his opinion, the mare would derive benefit from today's run.
